snippet.title: Fragmented Soul: Blackrock  V0.5.1.5 - Story-Teaser-Trailer
snippet.description:
Blackrock V0.5.1.5 - Story-Teaser-Trailer

👉 Blackrock v0.5.1.5 is available on Steam in Early-Access:
       https://store.steampowered.com/app/3752770/Blackrock/

Join the fight. Contain the unknown.
A mysterious force has landed.

Explore the evolving worlds of Blackrock, where every shard matters and every decision could tip the balance. With new features, improvements, and a deepening atmosphere, version 0.5.1.5 marks the second small step on the Story.

⚡ Atmospheric strategy meets alien corruption
🎮 Unique gameplay and evolving mechanics
🌌 Dive into a world full of danger, discovery, and dark energy

Watch the trailer and witness the awakening. Now with a preview for the Ground Omega mission and the escape from sector F23 of the Blackrock story alongside the Skirmish and Karmabattle (If you can find it :) ).
